note: The pink ghost carried across each cut reads clearly, and the held eye draining its stain is the best stillness in the film. But the dark of the third movement was not dark (mean brightness 51 of 255), the pink there read as a tint, and the flower was a white image pasted in. The cutting stopped accelerating at 8.5 s, and the blinks read as flat red bars.

The dark now measures dark (over 90% of pixels below luma 20) and the flower stays pink (hue around 330 degrees). But the held glow peaked brighter than the pink it came from, the leftover at the top of frame did not fade, the cutting flattened into a constant four-frame strobe for its last six seconds, and the blinks read as a symmetric wipe rather than eyelids.
